name: Rick Stehr, R.A.S.
quote: My passion in life is to help the family farm succeed, grow and develop to meet their goals for the betterment of all the family.

name: Jackie Behr, P.A.S.
quote: I enjoy researching, analyzing and problem solving to make a difference in overall farm profitability and animal health. I am also passionate about milk education and enjoy working with 97 MILK to help make a positive impact on the family-owned dairy farms.

name: Kevin Smith, P.A.S.
quote: There is no better feeling, than helping the men and women farmers that I've come to know, do the best they can, and make a difference for their farms and their families.

name: Steve Snyder
quote: Having worked and co-owned my family farm for over 25 years I understand first-hand the opportunities and challenges dairy farmers face.
